categories.main_business_segments: Henan Qingshuiyuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in water treatment chemicals production and sales, industrial water treatment engineering, and environmental comprehensive management. The company has developed into a group covering water treatment chemical R&D, production, sales, industrial water treatment services, municipal sewage treatment, and ecological restoration projects. It owns multiple subsidiaries specializing in water treatment chemicals, environmental engineering, intelligent water treatment systems, and related equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis technologies for water treatment agents such as HEDP, ATMP, DTPMP, and polymer-based products. It employs multi-stage reaction towers, continuous online production, and gas protection systems to improve efficiency and product stability. The firm also integrates intelligent monitoring and control systems in water treatment processes, leveraging industrial internet platforms for dynamic system management and energy-saving operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial sectors such as chemical, steel, power, petrochemical, mining, papermaking, and municipal water treatment entities. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports accounting for about 25% of revenue. Its products and services cater to industrial water treatment, municipal and drinking water treatment, sewage and wastewater treatment, and environmental protection projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Jiyuan City, Henan Province. It has subsidiaries in Shanghai, Beijing, Shaanxi, Hainan, and overseas presence through subsidiaries in the United States. Its sales cover domestic markets extensively and international markets accounting for approximately one-quarter of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Qingshuiyuan operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment industry supply chain. It produces water treatment chemicals (midstream), provides industrial water treatment engineering and environmental services (downstream), and manufactures related equipment. The company sources raw materials like yellow phosphorus, liquid chlorine, and glacial acetic acid from upstream chemical suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green and environmentally friendly water treatment chemicals, including low-phosphorus, nitrogen-free, biodegradable, and non-toxic products. It invests in R&D for new polymeric flocculants, multi-functional composite agents, nanomaterials, and microbial flocculants. The firm also focuses on digital transformation, integrating AI, big data, and IoT into its industrial internet platform to enhance intelligent water treatment services and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of water treatment chemicals and related derivative products, engineering contracting services (EPC, BOT, BT models), equipment sales, and operation and maintenance services. The company secures contracts mainly via direct sales, bidding, and partnerships with service providers, with a combination of domestic and export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic enterprises in the water treatment chemical industry, with a significant scale advantage and advanced technology. It competes with other mid-to-large scale chemical producers like Taihe Technology. The market is fragmented with many small and medium players, but Qingshuiyuan holds a strong position due to its product quality, R&D capabilities, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a 3.77% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 58.6 million. Despite the loss, cash flow from operating activities improved by nearly 70%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 2.56 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.43 billion. It continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Henan Qingshuiyuan emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced water treatment chemicals with a broad product portfolio tailored for diverse industrial and municipal applications. Its value proposition includes stable supply capacity, strong R&D and innovation capabilities, comprehensive technical support, and integrated intelligent water treatment solutions. The company also highlights its commitment to green chemistry and environmental compliance, positioning itself as a trusted partner in sustainable water management.
